title: Simplify failure delete controls
summary: Simplified the Reports delete/clear UI for failure artifacts, active error records, archived evidence, and operator notices without changing backend-owned mutation routes.
reason: The existing controls exposed backend marker/cleanup jargon and extra browser confirmation prompts, making delete actions harder to understand and operate.
behavior_before: Reports used labels such as marker cleanup and preview cleanup, showed redundant browser confirmation prompts after successful previews, and notice toasts used a generic Close action.
behavior_after: Reports uses Delete artifacts, Preview delete, Clear errors, Preview clear, active errors, and Dismiss notice labels. Clear/archive confirmation buttons still require backend preview state, JSON confirmation fields, and fingerprints where the backend requires them, but the extra browser confirmation prompt is removed.
rollback_plan: Revert the Reports label and command-helper text changes plus regenerated WebView baselines and summaries from this packet; backend cleanup routes are unchanged.
notes:
